summary: Phase 1 Periodización new views (Árbol / Kanban / Tabla) tested end-to-end with Super Admin on plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (4 macros, 12 mesos, 47 micros). All 3 new views render with correct data-testids, load chips, inline editing, Excel export, and per-user persistence via localStorage. Regression on Dashboard/Estructura/Calendario/Gráfico OK.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on a macro/meso row does NOT toggle collapse. Default state derives from `open[mk] !== false` (open), but toggle sets `!p[k]` which turns undefined→true — still evaluates open. It takes 2 clicks to collapse the first time. Observed: 1st click → mesos still visible (5), 2nd click → collapsed (0). Fix: initialize state to true or use `!(open[mk] !== false)` in toggle.

After editing a Vol cell (0 → 77) and pressing Enter, the value updates correctly in the cell and persists, but the 'Guardado' toast was NOT detected via [data-sonner-toast]/[role=status] selectors (empty array). Value save works, only the visual confirmation toast may be missing or dismissed too fast. Please verify updateMicroField shows toast.success('Guardado') in PeriodizationComplete.js (~line 767).

action_items: TreeView: fix first-click toggle for macros/mesos so a single click collapses the initially-open row.
TableView inline edit: verify 'Guardado' toast is fired on autosave (updateMicroField). Value persists correctly but toast not observed.
critical_code_review_comments: PeriodizationComplete.js is 3638 lines — recommend splitting (render*, handlers, view components) to keep <700 lines per file.
TreeView toggle logic in PeriodizationViews.jsx has an off-by-one state (undefined→true both = 'open').

Kanban HTML5 drag-and-drop was NOT verified in this run (Playwright HTML5 drag automation unreliable). Cards render draggable=true (47/47). Manual/QA verification recommended for the moveMicrocycle persistence path.
